question: Select the most appropriate option for blank 2.
solution:
The correct answer is 'persuade'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let us look into the meaning of the given options - 
 
 
• deactivate - make (something) inactive by disconnecting or destroying it.
 
• dissuade - persuade (someone) not to take a particular course of action.
 
• discourage - cause (someone) to lose confidence or enthusiasm.
 
• persuade - induce (someone) to do something through reasoning or argument.
 
 
 
• The given blank needs a word that would explain the coaxing done towards the employees. 
 
• From the above meanings it is clear that persuade is the appropriate word for the given blank. 
 
• Hence, option 4 is the correct answer. 

*Correct passage - **(1) Rapid changes in science and technology lead to modernisation of technology as well as upgradation of knowledge. In order to upgrade or modernise technology, management must (2) persuade employees to accept new technology. (3) Regular training of staff becomes necessary to update their knowledge and to (4) enhance their skills. This is possible only (5) through effective communication between the management and the employees.*
